name: oblivion-m13-{scene}-item-matrix

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start={start}
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[Models]
load unsupported nif files = true
[Shaders]
force shaders = true
[General]
screenshot format = png
